segments.name: AAON Oklahoma
segments.description: Engineers, manufactures, and sells highly configurable HVAC systems, controls solutions, and aftermarket parts for commercial and industrial customers.
segments.evidence: AAON Oklahoma engineers, manufactures, and sells highly configurable HVAC systems, designs and manufactures controls solutions, and sells aftermarket parts to customers through retail part stores and online.

segments.name: AAON Coil Products
segments.description: Engineers, manufactures, and sells semi-custom and custom HVAC systems and heating and cooling coils, primarily for the other AAON segments.
segments.evidence: AAON Coil Products engineers and manufactures and sells semi-custom and custom HVAC systems as well as heating and cooling coils for use in HVAC systems, primarily for AAON Oklahoma, AAON Coil Products, and BASX.

segments.name: BASX
segments.description: Engineers, manufactures, and sells custom cooling, ventilation, and air handling solutions for data center, cleanroom, and other markets.
segments.evidence: BASX engineers, manufactures, and sells a wide range of custom, high-performance cooling solutions for the rapidly growing hyperscale data center market; ventilation solutions for cleanroom environments in the biopharmaceutical, semiconductor, medical, and agricultural sectors; and highly customized air handlers and modular solutions for a variety of markets.

revenueModel.text: The company builds to order and sells highly configurable HVAC equipment, coils, and custom solutions to commercial, industrial, data center, and cleanroom customers, largely through independent sales representatives.
revenueModel.evidence: Unlike manufacturers of standardized equipment, we build to order, ensuring every system is pre-specified before production begins.
